get.summary: List a human's linked game accounts

post.description: Links a player ID to the human. 409 if the player ID or label is already linked to this human; 422 when invalid or over the 50-account limit. Triggers a state reload.

parameters.description: Game player ID (ASCII letters or digits, case-sensitive).
parameters.name: player_id

schema.description: Game player ID (ASCII letters or digits, case-sensitive).

parameters.description: Game player ID (ASCII letters or digits, case-sensitive).
parameters.name: player_id

schema.description: Game player ID (ASCII letters or digits, case-sensitive).

put.summary: Set or clear a linked account's label

location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. 'body.items[3].tags' or 'path.thing-id'

value.description: The value at the given location

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
examples: Property foo is required but is missing.

errors.description: Optional list of individual error details

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. This value should not change between occurrences of the error.

type.description: A URI reference to human-readable documentation for the error.

label.description: Optional label, unique per human (case-insensitive). null when unset.

player_id.description: Game player ID: 1-256 ASCII letters or digits, case-sensitive.
Game player ID: 1-256 ASCII letters or digits, case-sensitive.

atk.description: Minimum ATK IV (0-15). Omit to impose no floor (stored as 0 = no floor). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

clean.description: Auto-delete the alert on expiry (clean bitmask bit 1). Omit to disable (default false). Returned as null when false.

costume.description: Costume id. Omit/null = any (stored 9000). 0 = no costume. N = that costume.

def.description: Minimum DEF IV (0-15). Omit to impose no floor (stored as 0 = no floor). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

distance.description: Radius in metres around the anchor location. Omit (or 0) to match by the profile's geofence areas instead of a radius — 0 means area-based, NOT zero metres (stored as 0). Values above the server's [tracking] max_distance are clamped to it. Returned as null when at its wildcard.

edit.description: Edit the original alert in place when the same encounter is re-sent (IV reveal, weather boost, species/form change), while the alert is within the server's pokemon_edit_window_mins (default 5); later updates arrive as threaded replies. The operator can disable pokemon edit ([tracking] pokemon_edit). Clean bitmask bit 2. Omit to disable (default false). Returned as null when false.

form.description: Form id (game-master). Omit to match any form (stored as 0 = any). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

gender.description: Gender filter: any|male|female|genderless. Omit to match any gender (defaults to 'any', stored as 0). Returned as null when 'any'.

max_atk.description: Maximum ATK IV (0-15). Omit to impose no ceiling (stored as 15 = the IV ceiling, i.e. no upper bound). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

max_cp.description: Maximum CP. Omit to impose no upper bound (stored as 9000 = the CP cap sentinel, i.e. no upper bound). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

max_def.description: Maximum DEF IV (0-15). Omit to impose no ceiling (stored as 15 = the IV ceiling, i.e. no upper bound). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

max_iv.description: Maximum IV %. Omit to impose no upper bound (stored as 100 = the IV ceiling, i.e. no upper bound). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

max_level.description: Maximum encounter level. Omit to impose no upper bound (stored as 55 = the level ceiling, i.e. no upper bound). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

max_rarity.description: Maximum rarity tier (1-6). Omit to impose no upper bound (stored as 6 = the top tier, i.e. no upper bound). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

max_size.description: Maximum size tier (1-5). Omit to impose no upper bound (stored as 5 = the top tier, i.e. no upper bound). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

max_sta.description: Maximum STA IV (0-15). Omit to impose no ceiling (stored as 15 = the IV ceiling, i.e. no upper bound). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

max_weight.description: Maximum weight in grams. Omit to impose no upper bound (stored as 9000000 = no upper weight sentinel). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

min_cp.description: Minimum CP. Omit to impose no lower bound (stored as 0 = no lower bound). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

min_iv.description: Minimum IV %. Omit to impose no lower bound (stored as -1 = no lower bound). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

min_level.description: Minimum encounter level. Omit to impose no lower bound (stored as 0 = no lower bound). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

min_time.description: Minimum seconds remaining on the spawn. Omit to impose no minimum (stored as 0 = no minimum). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

min_weight.description: Minimum weight in grams. Omit to impose no lower bound (stored as 0 = no lower bound). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

override_areas.description: Restrict this rule to these geofence areas (mutually exclusive with distance > 0 and override_location_label). Omit for none. Returned as null when unset.

override_location_label.description: Saved-location label to use instead of the profile location (requires distance > 0; mutually exclusive with override_areas). Omit for none. Returned as null when unset.

personal_background.description: Only alert when the pokemon has the special (event) background for one of the human's linked accounts (personal bitmask bit 2). Same requirements as personal_shiny; when both are set both must hold. Omit for false. Returned as null when false.

personal_shiny.description: Only alert when the pokemon is shiny for one of the human's linked game accounts (personal bitmask bit 1). Needs the server's [shiny_rates] feed; matches nothing until it loads or while the human has no linked accounts. Omit for false. Returned as null when false.

ping.description: Text appended to the alert, typically Discord role/user mentions. Stored verbatim — not restricted to mention tokens as the bot is, so @everyone/@here in a channel rule will ping. Omit for none. Returned as null when empty.

pokemon_id.description: Pokédex id. Omit (or null) for the catch-all that matches EVERY pokemon — stored as 0. Returned as null for the catch-all.

pvp_ranking_best.description: Best (lowest, 1-based) PVP rank to alert on. Omit to start from rank 1 (stored as 1 = best possible rank). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

pvp_ranking_cap.description: PVP level cap. Omit to use the league default cap (stored as 0 = league default). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

pvp_ranking_evolution.description: Temp-evolution (mega) PVP discriminator selecting which evolution's PVP rank this rule alerts on: 0 = base form, 1 = Mega, 2 = Mega X, 3 = Mega Y. Omit for base form (stored as 0). Returned as null when at its wildcard (0).

pvp_ranking_league.description: PVP league CP cap (the stored int IS the cap): 0 | 500 | 1500 | 2500. Omit (or 0) for IV-mode tracking with no PVP filter (stored as 0 = none/IV mode). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

pvp_ranking_min_cp.description: PVP CP floor. Omit to impose no floor (stored as 0 = no floor). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

pvp_ranking_worst.description: Worst (highest) PVP rank to alert on. Omit to impose no upper rank limit (stored as 4096 = no upper rank limit sentinel; PVP ranks never exceed it). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

rarity.description: Minimum rarity tier. Omit to match any rarity (stored as -1 = any). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

size.description: Minimum size tier. Omit to match any size (stored as -1 = any). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

sta.description: Minimum STA IV (0-15). Omit to impose no floor (stored as 0 = no floor). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

summary.description: Route into the summary digest (clean bitmask bit 4). Omit to disable (default false). Returned as null when false.

template.description: DTS template name. Omit (or empty) to use the server's configured default template (stored as ""). Returned as null when at its wildcard.
